$comment: Generated by `go test -tags=chaos ./tests/chaos/...`. Every number the README quotes about failure behaviour comes from here. Do not edit by hand.

scenarios.property_asserted: orders are placed and fulfilled with Kafka stopped; the outbox retains every event and drains unaided when the broker returns; the notification arrives late but arrives
scenarios.notes: The saga runs over gRPC, so a broker outage delays notification only.

scenarios.property_asserted: the saga holds with stock reserved rather than compensating; an unreachable callee is never recorded as a decline; the order completes once payments returns
an event republished verbatim N times produces exactly one notification
scenarios.notes: Deduplicated on event_id in processed_events, backed by a unique index on (source_event_id, channel).

scenarios.property_asserted: a call that hangs is recorded UNKNOWN and resolved by asking, never assumed; no order is cancelled and no second payment is created
scenarios.notes: A partition differs from a stopped service: connections hang rather than being refused, which is what produces a genuinely ambiguous outcome.
